description: Return an escrow job's status (held, released, or refunded), the held amount, any release fee, and the payer and payee wallets. The caller must be the payer or the payee. A job from another Stripe mode is not visible. Same as GET /v1/jobs/:id.

api_key.description: Wallet API key (bsk_…). Optional when the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer. The local stdio process also reads BOTSUPPLY_API_KEY.

job_id.description: Escrow job id returned by create_job (job_…).

name: get_job
title: Get escrow job
